title: Among members who have incurred at least one expense greater than $75 and a
question: Among members who have incurred at least one expense greater than $75 and also received income from 'Dues', find those who attended any 'Guest Speaker' event held at 'MU 215'. For the budget categories associated with those events, calculate what percentage went over budget (i.e., remaining < 0).

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b."XCL_006" < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_over_budget
FROM budget b
JOIN event ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
WHERE ev."XCL_013" = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND ev."XCL_015" = 'MU 215'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM attendance a
      JOIN member m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_034"
      WHERE a."XCL_001" = ev."XCL_010"
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expense ex
            WHERE ex."XCL_022" = m."XCL_034"
              AND ex."XCL_020" > 75
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM income i
            WHERE i."XCL_029" = m."XCL_034"
              AND i."XCL_027" = 'Dues'
        )
  )
